study_identification_part.si_4_title: Linking Personalized Brain Atrophy to Schizophrenia Network and Treatment Response

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Retrospective data from the hospital database of Anhui Medical University / Anhui Mental Health Center
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: The magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) data of 797 healthy subjects and 91 schizophrenia patients... were retrospectively selected from our hospital database... Schizophrenia patients were enrolled in the Anhui Mental Health Center (Hefei, China).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Ji2023.pdf.md: Abstract; Materials and methods / Participants

answer.SINGLE-SITE: 797 healthy subjects for normative training (cortical thickness); 652 of them for normative functional connectivity (atrophy network); 91 schizophrenia patients for clinical research; 60 healthy subjects for normative model validation

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Local hospital database used for all components: normative model construction, validation, and clinical application in schizophrenia patients
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: The healthy subjects were used to establish normative reference ranges for cortical thickness... atrophy network was mapped using resting-state functional connectivity MRI from a subgroup of healthy subjects (n = 652)... 91 schizophrenia patients were included... we additionally collected structural MRI data of an independent healthy group (n = 60... to validate the normative model.

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Model-1 used 797 HC for training and 60 HC for validation (total 857). Model-2 used 652 HC (subgroup of the 797) to create normative connectivity maps.
